Scope: Type 1 and Type 2 perimeter fence, main and chain-link gates, and guard rooms with water tanks, with their mechanical and electrical works (lighting, gate barriers, intrusion detection). Contract duration 91 days; contract value 16,500,001.96 SAR.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours (25,284 man-hours in total). At 03-Nov-2026 the project is 98.4% complete against 100% planned, behind by 1.6%, after gaining 0.51% (130 man-hours) this week. The contract completion date of 05-Aug-2026 passed 90 days ago.

The project is 90 days past its contract completion date, and the P6 handover date of 02-Nov-2026 has passed with work still open. The P6 file uploaded this week (named DD03-11-2026) still has a data date of 27-Oct-2026 and was not rescheduled. It keeps initial handover on 02-Nov-2026, 89 days after the contract date of 05-Aug-2026, with −70.5 to −75 days of float on the 21 open activities, all of which were due by that date. The weekly report still gives 05-Aug-2026 as the forecast completion. Construction is unchanged at 99.9%; handing over rose to 33.4% and testing and commissioning to 87.5%. Four issues in the issue log were reopened this week.

Data notes

  • Physical % complete is taken from the Progress sheet of the weekly report (earned vs budgeted man-hours). The "Actual %" column in the P6 PDF layouts and the earned-value cells of the weekly report are cost-based, so they are not used.
  • This week's gain is the difference between the earned man-hours of the 03-Nov-2026 report (24,887) and the 27-Oct-2026 report (24,757); the previous-week columns of the 03-Nov report agree. Quantities this week are not available.
  • Dates disagree inside the weekly report: the General Information sheet gives site handover 06-May-2026 and completion 05-Aug-2026 (as does the P6 baseline), while the Milestones sheet gives award 16-Apr-2026, handover 30-Apr-2026 and completion 30-Aug-2026. The lower table of the Milestones sheet belongs to another fence project (SUD1-05-015).
  • The weekly report still forecasts completion on 05-Aug-2026 with zero variance, although that date has passed; P6 forecasts 02-Nov-2026.
  • The P6 file uploaded this week is named DD03-11-2026 but has a data date of 27-Oct-2026 and was not rescheduled: activity percentages were updated, but its remaining dates (28-Oct to 02-Nov-2026) are now in the past.
  • The FIR summary records inspections on 01-Nov-2026 for three chain-link gates (one 6 m, two 5 m) and 4.3 LM of Type 1 steel fence with pedestrian gates, while the P6 file still shows the chain-link gate activity at 0%.
  • In the P6 update, the Construction and Project Finish milestones are marked complete on 16-Sep-2026 while 21 activities are still in progress. Actual dates start on 13-Jul-2026 (Project Start), two months after handover; the electrical gate barrier shows an actual start of 12-Apr-2026, before the contract award.
  • The Major Quantities sheet is not usable: actual quantities are fractions of one unit (for example 0.25 LM of 18,500 LM of chain-link fence) and its resource table is from another project. The scope section is left out.
  • The Procurement sheet carries another project's code and has delivery data for only a few minor items, so the procurement section is left out.
  • The invoice log shows a revised contract value of 21,100,000, an estimate at completion of 20,900,000 and potential changes of 200,000, against 16,500,001.96 and 0 in the General Information and Weekly Progress Report sheets.
  • The project stage is still "Mobilization" in the weekly report, and the MODON PM field is empty; the PM's name is taken from the HSE inspection sheet. The quality checklist names the contractor (HMA) as the consultant.
  • The issue log reopened four items that were marked closed last week, keeping their original target dates; the risk log still marks all items closed while its "current status" column reads "In Progress", and the Top 5 issues panel is empty. Several summary panels show #REF! or #N/A errors.
